name: grasshopper-website
description: Static build tooling for grasshoppersolutions.online. The site itself is plain HTML/CSS/JS with no runtime build step; this generates the English and Spanish pages from src/ templates + i18n/ strings, and compiles the Tailwind stylesheet ahead of time so visitors never download the CDN compiler.

scripts.build: npm run build:i18n && npm run build:css && npm run check:links
